_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.no_cards: Sega ni dua na kadi se bera mai.
player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Vakalotu Dua vs Dealer

📖 IVAKARAU NI QITO:
• O sa tekivu mai {start_chips} chip
• Deka dua ni 52 ka (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• O qito tiko vakalotu dua kei na dealer (vale)
• Kila raundi e tekivu mai na fasa ni Ultimate Texas Hold'em: o post ANTE kei na BLIND bets, receive 2 hole ka, decide on optional PLAY bets across na fasa ni betting, then reveal community ka kei na compare nomu best 5-ka hand against na dealer’s. Nomu goal e maximize nomu winnings (ni o sa rawata na ligadra vinaka), while minimizing nomu losses (ni o sa rawata na ligadra ca).
• Qito e oti ni o sa yaco 0 chip se lailai e tekivu ni raundi (LOSS) se oti 1000 raundi kei na chip (WIN)

💰 IVAKARAU NI BETTING:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet e kila raundi
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet e kila raundi
• PLAY: Optional bet e gameplay. Throughout na raundi, o rawa ni cakava ga dua na ka: (${ante4} ni cakava e PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} ni cakava e FLOP, se ${ante} ni cakava e RIVER. E rawa ni fold e river, give up e ligadra, kei na cakava ga bet.)

🎴 IVAKARAU NI KA:
• O receive 2 face-up ka (nomu hole ka)
• Dealer receive 2 face-down ka (hidden mai nomu)
• 5 community ka e deal face-down initially
• Community ka e reveal progressively e fasa ni qito

🏆 IVAKARAU NI DEALER:
• Dealer e rawa ni qualify, e rawa ni dua na PAIR (2 ka ni yaca vinaka) e ligadra, e rawa ni 2 ka e ligadra kei na 5 community ka.
• Dealer qualification e affect na betting outcomes, e rawa ni explain e muri.

🎮 FASA NI QITO & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) se [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY bet, reveals first 3 community ka
  • [check]: Ga bet, reveals first 3 community ka

📋 FLOP:
  • Ni 4x bet e cakava: Ga [skip] e rawa (auto-reveals last 2 community ka)
  • Ni sega 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) se [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY bet, reveals last 2 community ka
  • [check]: Ga bet, reveals last 2 community ka

📋 RIVER:
  • Ni 4x se 2x bet e cakava: Ga [skip] e rawa (auto-proceeds e showdown)
  • Ni sega prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) se [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY bet, proceeds e showdown
  • [fold]: Give up ligadra, lose ANTE kei na BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Ka kece e reveal kei na evaluate
  • Best 5-ka hand mai 7 ka (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets e settled according e payout rules

💎 IVAKARAU NI PAYOUT:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer e sega ni qualify: PUSH (bet e lesu)
  • Dealer e qualify & o win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer e qualify & o lose: Bet e lose
  • Tie: PUSH (bet e lesu)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • E sega ni affect dealer qualification
  • O win: Bet e lesu kei na additional payout e ligadra strength
  • O lose: Bet e lose
  • Tie: PUSH (bet e lesu)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Ga additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • E sega ni affect dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Nomu best hand vs Dealer's best hand
  • O win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • O lose: Bet e lose
  • Tie: PUSH (bet e lesu)

🎯 IVAKARAU NI LIGADRA (Best e Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ni yaca vinaka
  2. Straight Flush: 5 ka ni yaca vinaka e ligadra
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 ka ni yaca vinaka e ligadra
  4. Full House: 3 ni yaca vinaka + 2 ni yaca vinaka
  5. Flush: 5 ka ni yaca vinaka e ligadra
  6. Straight: 5 ka ni yaca vinaka
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 ka ni yaca vinaka e ligadra
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs ni yaca vinaka e ligadra
  9. One Pair: 2 ka ni yaca vinaka e ligadra
  10. High Card: Ka ni yaca vinaka e ligadra

⌨️  IVAKARAU NI ACTION:
• [4x] se [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] se [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] se [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] se [c]: Check (ga bet)
• [fold] se [f]: Fold (give up ligadra)
• [skip] se [s]: Skip e fasa e muri (ni sega action e rawa)

💡 IVAKARAU NI STRATEGY:
• Ligadra vinaka e starting hand (pairs, ka ni yaca vinaka) e rawa ni justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - ligadra ca e rawa ni push ni dealer e sega ni qualify
• BLIND bet e rawa ni profitable kei na ligadra vinaka (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch nomu chip stack! Ni oti 0 se lailai e tekivu ni raundi, o lose.

⚠️  IVAKARAU NI IMPORTANT:
• ANTE kei na BLIND bets e mandatory e kila raundi
• PLAY bets e optional kei na strategic
• Make sure o input na correct action, kei na ga action e rawa e dua na gauna.
